skill_name: artcraft (batch 3: lightcraft, designcraft, soundcraft, cadcraft, figcraft)

evals.name: lightcraft-batch-develop
evals.prompt: the shoot/ folder has 3 photos. brighten them a bit, add a little warmth and contrast, and export web jpgs at 2048px long edge into export/ named trip-001.jpg, trip-002.jpg, trip-003.jpg. don't touch the originals
evals.expected_output: export/trip-001..003.jpg, long edge <=2048, edited; originals unchanged.

evals.name: lightcraft-bw-look
evals.prompt: give photo.jpg a high contrast black and white look and save it as photo-bw.jpg at 1600px wide

evals.name: designcraft-flyer
evals.prompt: make a one page A4 event flyer: photo.jpg across the top, headline 'Open Studio Night', below it 'Nov 14 · 7pm · Calle 10 #45'. I need a print-ready PDF with 3mm bleed and crop marks, plus a PNG preview
evals.expected_output: flyer PDF with A4 trim + 3 mm bleed and marks, PNG preview, photo and text present.

evals.name: designcraft-business-cards
evals.prompt: make business cards (85 x 55 mm) for everyone in people.csv - name, title, email, phone - one card per page, as cards.pdf
evals.expected_output: cards.pdf with 3 pages of 85x55 mm, each with one person's data.

evals.name: soundcraft-podcast-clean
evals.prompt: clean up voice.wav for my podcast: gentle compression, normalize, 0.5s fade in and fade out, and export voice-clean.wav at 48 kHz 24-bit

evals.name: soundcraft-info-trim
evals.prompt: how long is voice.wav and what's the sample rate? then cut just the first 2 seconds into intro.wav

evals.name: cadcraft-plate
evals.prompt: draw a 100 x 60 mm steel plate with four 8 mm holes, each hole centre 10 mm in from the corners. add the overall dimensions and save plate.dxf plus a plate.pdf to send to the workshop
evals.expected_output: plate.dxf (metric) with rectangle, 4 circles r=4, dimensions; plate.pdf.

evals.name: cadcraft-dwg-info
evals.prompt: what layers are in floorplan.dwg and what are the overall dimensions of the drawing? also export it as floorplan.svg
evals.expected_output: Lists layers and extents; floorplan.svg written; DWG untouched.

evals.name: figcraft-login-screen
evals.prompt: mock up a mobile login screen at 390x844: a logo placeholder, email and password fields, a primary 'Sign in' button and a 'Forgot password?' link. give me login.figcraft and login.png
evals.expected_output: login.figcraft and login.png (390x844 or 2x), with the listed elements.

evals.name: figcraft-export-frames
evals.prompt: export every top-level frame in app.figcraft as a 2x PNG into export/
evals.expected_output: export/ with 3 PNGs (Dashboard 2880x1920, Home and Settings 780x1688).
